# cr-ci build-runner-image.sh (dry-run) project=example-project region=us-central1
# dry-run: nothing is changed; '?' lines are read-only checks, assumed to find nothing
# C7: runner image gh-runner:golden
? gcloud artifacts docker images describe us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/example-project/cr-runners/gh-runner:golden --project=example-project '--format=value(image_summary.digest)'
+ gcloud builds submit runner --config=scripts/cloudbuild.yaml --substitutions=_IMAGE=us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/example-project/cr-runners/gh-runner:golden,_DOCKERFILE=Dockerfile --gcs-source-staging-dir=gs://example-project-cr-ci-staging/source --service-account=projects/example-project/serviceAccounts/cr-runner-build-sa@example-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com --region=us-central1 --project=example-project
# done; next: deploy-mediator.sh if the mediator changed too, then deploy-job.sh --tag golden
